name: Mississippi
dueDateNotes: Mississippi follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Mississippi exempts the first $10,000 of taxable income and taxes the rest at a flat 4.0% for 2026 (down from 4.4% in 2025 under the Build Up Mississippi Act). This estimate applies the standard deduction ($2,300 single / $4,600 joint) plus the personal exemption ($6,000 / $12,000); the $1,500-per-dependent exemption is not modeled.
uniqueFacts: Mississippi's flat rate drops to 4.0% for 2026 (from 4.4% in 2025) and continues falling toward 3% under the Build Up Mississippi Act.
Mississippi exempts the first $10,000 of taxable income entirely, so only income above that is taxed.
Mississippi requires estimated payments once your liability tops $200 and withholding covers less than 80% of it.
